summary: Preserved the candidate's valid exact-request Qwen preprocessing cache and corrected its reproducible concurrent-cold-request race with cancellation-safe single-flight. The original save/load-by-ID contract remains incomplete: prompt-independent reuse, an explicit OpenAI operation, shared/durable lifecycle, and video/audio support are not implemented.

tests.command: candidate 5a5fa419: mandated Python invoking pytest for test_qwen_preprocess_request_cache.py, test_preprocess_cache.py, and test_mm_hashes.py with candidate source first on sys.path
tests.what_was_measured: Exact candidate behavior: 38 passed and 5 subtests passed.
The same image SHA-256 content ID produces a different request cache key when only the rendered prompt changes.

Corrected behavior: 39 passed and 5 subtests passed, including one owner computation, one single-flight join, and mutation isolation between simultaneous callers. The full related suite passed 115 tests and 30 subtests.

gpu_execution.evidence: AMD Instinct MI355X/gfx950 inventory was recorded, but no qualifying Qwen-VL weights were available. The supplied tiny Llama fixture cannot validate Qwen multimodal preprocessing or semantic equivalence.

remaining_limitations: Changed prompts miss because the rendered prompt remains part of the exact-output cache key.
There is no explicit OpenAI API operation to save and later load preprocessing by a caller-selected ID.
Entries remain process-local, are not shared across tokenizer workers, and do not survive restart.
Video and audio preprocessing remain excluded.
No qualifying Qwen-VL model weights were available for end-to-end serving or independent numerical validation.
No native code changed; native rebuild was not applicable.
